BehaviorTree._description: Before you run this, follow the Camera Calibration guide at https://docs.picknik.ai/how_to/robotics_applications/camera_calibration/. Generates the waypoints for the camera calibration Objectives. Start with the arm at a pose where the camera sees the whole ChArUco calibration board, then run. The Objective tilts that pose in view_count directions, shifts each tilted pose by up to max_translation so the board moves around the image and changes size between waypoints, moves the arm to each pose, and saves it as a waypoint named waypoint_prefix_01, _02, and so on. Set pivot_distance to about the distance from the end effector to the board when the camera is on the arm, or to 0 when the board is on the arm and the camera is fixed in the workspace. A camera on the arm must look along the z axis of end_effector_frame. A pose the arm cannot reach is skipped with a warning. Waypoints with the same names are replaced. Waypoints from an earlier run with higher numbers stay; delete them by hand.

SubTree.input_port: Prefix of the waypoint names. Use the same prefix in the calibration Objective.
About the distance from the end effector to the ChArUco board, measured along the end effector's z axis, in meters. Use 0 when the board is on the arm.
How far each waypoint tilts away from the starting pose, in degrees.

Largest shift of each waypoint from its tilted pose along each of its own axes, in meters. The shifts follow a fixed pattern that moves the board around the image and changes its size between waypoints. Keep it well below pivot_distance for a camera on the arm. Use 0 to keep the board centered.
Number of waypoints to generate. The calibration needs at least 5.
Link of the arm the waypoints are generated for. A camera on the arm must look along the z axis of this link.
Joint group that moves to each waypoint.
